title: 第34章 升任保健站大夫
content_zh:
第34章 升任保健站大夫-《赶山1957：二斤猪肉换个媳妇》

上一章

存书签

下一章

石溪村的村民听闻，纷纷对视一眼后走了过来，刚刚赵贵家中的事情和他们没关系，他们就纯属看个热闹，日后当作茶余饭后的谈资，度过这无聊没有太多娱乐的日子。

但是，卫生所可是关系到村里所有人的利益。

石溪村上一个保健站的大夫，去年冬天的时候走了，一直没有找到合适的人选，这才空到了现在，不少地方也称呼保健站为医疗站，后来又有了土诊所的称呼。

乡里面的诊所称之为乡卫生所，也叫联合诊所，李青山喜欢称之为乡诊所，叫起来更上口一些。

县城里面的诊所，那就不叫诊所了，叫医院，比如说县卫生院，或者县医院！

保健站的大夫都是从贫下中农产生，经历村长和支书提名，乡政府审核，县卫生院审批通过，再去接受三个月的培训，就可以担任保健站的大夫了，所以现在的李青山，尚且不算是正式上岗，还要等到李胜利提名，乡政府审核等一系列流程后才行。

至于去县医院培训这个东西，培训的是现代医学，李青山还是要找个时间过去的，三个月也不长，关键是李青山这小子有了乡诊所华大夫的认可，稍微打一声招呼，乡里面和县里面不可能不通过的。

而且，李青山这小子在医术上，确实是有一手的。

“村长，可不能找个二流子去保健站啊，这不是拿咱们的小命开玩笑吗？”

“就是，这么年轻，靠谱吗？”

石溪村的百姓纷纷围了上来，七嘴八舌对李青山和李胜利攻击道。

“干什么，都干什么？”

“李青山完全符合保健站大夫的条件，这件事情提上去后等到乡政府审核审批后，青山还要去县医院培训三个月的，只要经历培训后毕业，那就是一个大夫，怎么就不能给大家伙看病了？”

“又不是现在让青山就给你们看病！”

“我这只是先将钥匙给青山，毕竟保健站没人打扫也不行，还有一些书，青山平日里也能翻一翻，学习学习，日后有更好的医术为大家服务。”

“有什么错？”

村长李胜利盯着想要闹事的村民道：“至于王乃香，什么情况你们不知道啊？”

“这孩子现在处境都这样了，你们还想落井下石？”

“去保健站住上一段时间又怎么了？大家都是乡亲，就应该互帮互助才是。”

李胜利一席话。

石溪村的百姓顿时哑口无言。

“哦，还要去县医院培训啊，我以为就直接上岗了呢！”

“村长，凭啥不让我去啊，我也能行啊！”

“就是，怎么不选我们？”

村子里的村民，又找到了新的方向不满道。

Chapter 34: Promoted to a doctor at a health station - "Climbing the Mountain 1957: Two pounds of pork in exchange for a wife"

When the villagers in Shixi Village heard this, they all looked at each other and came over. What happened at Zhao Gui's house just now had nothing to do with them. They just wanted to watch the excitement and use it as conversation material after dinner to spend their boring days without much entertainment.

However, the health center is related to the interests of everyone in the village.

The doctor at a health station in Shixi Village left last winter, and no suitable candidate was found, so he is now vacant. In many places, the health station is also called a medical station, and later it was also called a local clinic.

The clinics in the township are called township health clinics, also called joint clinics. Li Qingshan likes to call them township clinics, which is more catchy.

A clinic in a county is not called a clinic, but a hospital, such as a county health center or a county hospital!

Doctors at health stations are all from poor and lower-middle peasants. After being nominated by the village chief and party secretary, reviewed by the township government, approved by the county health center, and then receiving three months of training, they can serve as doctors at the health station. Therefore, Li Qingshan is not yet officially on the job. He has to wait until Li Shengli is nominated, reviewed by the township government, and other processes.

As for going to the county hospital for training, the training is about modern medicine. Li Qingshan still has to find a time to go there. Three months is not long. The key is that Li Qingshan has the approval of Dr. Hua from the township clinic. If he just says hello, there is no way he will fail in the township and county.

Moreover, Li Qingshan is indeed very skilled in medical skills.

"Village chief, you can't hire a second-rate guy to go to the health center. Isn't this just a joke on our lives?"

"That's right, so young, is it reliable?"

The people of Shixi Village gathered around and attacked Li Qingshan and Li Shengli.

"What are you doing?"

"Li Qingshan fully meets the conditions for a doctor at a health station. After this matter is brought up and approved by the township government, Qingshan will have to go to the county hospital for three months of training. As long as he graduates after undergoing training, he will be a doctor. Why can't he treat everyone?"

"It's not like I'm going to ask Qingshan to treat you right now!"

"I'm just giving the key to Qingshan first. After all, it won't work if there is no one to clean the health station. There are also some books. Qingshan can look through them on weekdays and study them so that he can serve everyone with better medical skills in the future."

"What's wrong?"

Village chief Li Shengli stared at the villagers who wanted to cause trouble and said, "As for Wang Naixiang, what situation don't you know about?"

"This child is in this situation now, and you still want to add insult to injury?"

"What's wrong with going to the health center and staying for a while? We are all fellow villagers, so we should help each other."

Li Shengli said something.

The people of Shixi Village were immediately speechless.

"Oh, I still need to go to the county hospital for training. I thought I would start working directly!"

"Village chief, why don't you let me go? I can do it too!"

"That's right, why didn't you choose us?"

The villagers in the village said dissatisfiedly as they found a new direction.
